summary.name: Keybase
summary.one_liner: Keybase is an end-to-end encrypted chat and file-sharing tool for individuals, families, clubs, and companies, with public key cryptography protecting messages.
keywords: end to end encrypted team tool
use_cases: encrypted group chat for families or roommates
sharing photos and documents privately with a group
chatting with communities linked to public identities
keeping club or friend group files private
summary.what_it_does: Keybase provides encrypted chat for groups, including families, roommates, clubs, friends, and companies. It uses public key cryptography so that messages stay private, and the page states that even the Keybase service cannot read chats. Users can connect their identity to public accounts such as Twitter and Reddit. Groups can store photos, videos, and documents with end-to-end encryption.
notable: Even the service operator says it cannot read users' chats
Connects user identities to public accounts like Twitter and Reddit
Encrypted group file storage for photos, videos, and documents
Listed in awesome-mac under Collaboration and Team Tools
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page text is mostly marketing and gives few technical details
